line_list.header:
The speed developers demand

The control platform teams require

items.title: Provision
items.text: Speed provisioning with a workflow that manages Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, and more, and provides developer self-service.

items.title: Configure
items.text: Extend IaC pipelines beyond provisioning to include configuration management by automating Ansible playbooks.

items.title: Govern
items.text: Give platform teams insight and control with resource visibility, Golden Paths, predefined policies, and automated drift detection.

Managing infrastructure at scale is a difficult balancing act. Get greater control over developer self-provisioning and enhanced security and compliance with a single integrated workflow for rapid infrastructure provisioning and configuration.

Overworked Infrastructure teams slow down projects. Give developers the ability to self-provision with automated workflows and guardrails that standardize the provisioning process, eliminate learning bottlenecks, and reduce time to market.

Rigid infrastructure tooling and practices don’t scale. Ensure changes reach production faster, more securely, and with fewer manual steps. End-to-end workflows integrate tools, set up environments based on best practices, and increase infrastructure flexibility.

Inconsistent infrastructure practices increase the need for manual requests, workflows, and intervention. Eliminate developer reliance on DevOps for compliant infrastructure provisioning and reduce the need for manual approvals, audits, and deprovisioning.

integrations.header: Orchestration that integrates with your existing tooling
integrations.text: Overcome automation tool sprawl. Connect to and orchestrate all of your infrastructure tooling. IaC, VCS, configuration management, observability tools, control solutions, and cloud providers – Spacelift connects to all of them to help you deliver secure infrastructure faster.
